scripts.dev:api: uv run --package kasa-api fastapi dev apps/api/kasa_api/main.py
scripts.start:api: uv run --package kasa-api uvicorn kasa_api.main:app --app-dir apps/api --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.test:api: uv run --package kasa-api python -m pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run build:web
